experience.title: Built to defend. Restored to welcome.
experience.text: In 1507, the Republic of Venice raised a stone bastion on the slopes of Monte Rocchetta to guard Riva del Garda and its port. Venetian rule over the town ended before the fortress ever saw battle, and for centuries it stood in ruin above the lake. A panoramic lift reconnected it to the town in the 1950s, and a careful restoration returned it to the city in 2008 — the same terrace where Bastione now serves Trentino and Mediterranean cooking, from morning until after dark.

moments.title: Moments above the lake
moments.description: Come to Bastione and make the view part of your story. Share a long lunch above Lake Garda, raise a glass as the mountains turn golden, or simply slow down and enjoy the moment with someone special. From the first light over Riva del Garda to evenings beneath the open sky, every table offers more than a view — it offers a moment to remember. Join us, take your time, and create memories that will stay with you long after you leave.

cuisine.title: Mountain meets Mediterranean
cuisine.description: The bold flavours of Trentino meet the fresh spirit of the Mediterranean. Local mountain ingredients, lake fish, alpine cheeses and traditional cured meats are reimagined with a contemporary touch. Every dish brings together the character of the mountains and the lightness of the south. A cuisine shaped by the landscape, the seasons and the view.
